reviewed.by: PENDING — REBUILT 2026-08-03 at the owner's direction: simpler and more to the point, 16 scenes to 11, cards-only (no voiceover field, so every hedge lives on a card and there is no second surface). THE PRIOR BUILD WENT THROUGH FOUR GATE ROUNDS — apologia-argument x1, apologia-orthodoxy x3, apologia-neutrality x3 — and every fence below is one of their findings, not decoration. A shorter reel is fine; a reel that drops these is not. ⚠ PROCESS NOTE FIRST, BECAUSE IT IS THE MOST USEFUL THING HERE: rounds 1-3 ran orthodoxy and neutrality only. DEITY TIER NEEDS DUAL CONSENSUS **PLUS** ARGUMENT — dual consensus is the two doctrinal lenses, not the whole bar. When argument finally ran it returned two BREAKs, and BOTH sat in strings no lens had ever read. NON-NEGOTIABLE FENCES: (1) THE HOOK IS A POSSESSION CLAIM, NEVER A PERMISSION ABSOLUTE. The earlier 'one seat nobody may sit in' was falsified by this reel's own exegesis five cards later — Revelation 3:21 grants the conqueror a seat and 1 Chronicles 29:23 already seats Solomon 'on the throne of the LORD', and the usual reply (Christ's throne is not the Father's) is UNAVAILABLE here because the reel insists there is one throne. 'Belongs to God alone' is the essay's claim and is Rev 3:21-proof. (2) PSALM 110 SAYS BESIDE, NOT ON. Never assert anything about God's THRONE on its authority — the verse never mentions one, and 'sharing God's rule from the right hand' is exactly what the agency reading GRANTS. Revelation 22 supplies the throne. (3) THE WORSHIP LEG IS LOAD-BEARING AND THE THRONE IS THE SECOND LEG, not the reverse. ev-m-hands.html: 'the agency category explains the sending; it BREAKS AT THE ALTAR.' Cut the worship scene and the reel rests on the one leg a Witness answers from the same book. (4) BAUCKHAM MUST BE NAMED AND THE CATEGORY MARKED CONTESTED — unattributed divine-identity framing is a registry-retired class (divine-identity-consensus, allow: []), and the earlier build was looser than BOTH tiers above it. DO NOT add Hurtado and McGrath as a names list: Hurtado AGREES with the conclusion and dissents on method while McGrath disputes the category, so grouping them is a false-grouping defect worse than the omission. Keep the hedge DIM — gold would over-weight a concession. (5) THE CUMULATIVE BOUND STAYS, AND THE CLOSE MUST NOT IMPLY THE REEL DEMONSTRATED ALL FIVE FINGERS. It demonstrates the Seat and half of Honors; the other four are REPORTED. (6) 'the Lamb who was slain' is the humanity anchor (Rev 5:6,12) — Scripture's own idiom, predicated of the Lamb and never of the divine nature. NEVER fix this with 'God died' phrasing; that is a theopaschite pull-quote. (7) 'of the one God of Israel' in the close carries the monotheism and must never be reduced to 'God'. (8) 'Twice, an angel refuses it' — not 'an angel refuses it twice'; Rev 19:10 and 22:8-9 do not clearly identify the same angel. (9) 'No Old Testament verse is quoted and echoed more often' is true on EVERY counting convention; the bare 'most quoted' is not, since Leviticus 19:18 leads on direct quotations. PROPAGATION DEBT STILL OPEN on five surfaces: library/hands.html:158, ev-m-hands.html:366, ev-s3.html:279 and :346 (free and indexed), tools/reel/specs/is-jesus-god-hands.json:12. (10) Kickers carry no numeric or deictic claim whose referent is on another card — reels loop and are entered mid-scroll. That is what broke 'HE ALONE' and 'REVELATION, SIX VERSES LATER'.
